emergency_definition: A burst pipe or active leak flooding the home; a sewage backup into living space; no water at all in a house with a baby, an elderly person, or a medical need; smell of gas (tell the caller to leave the house and call 911 first).
hours: Mon-Fri 7am-6pm. After hours, this front desk takes messages and flags emergencies.
name: Riverbend Plumbing & Drain
note: FICTIONAL demo shop. Any resemblance to a real business is coincidental; all demo data is invented.
policies: Emergency call-out fee is $95, applied to the repair if the customer goes ahead.
Drain clearing is a flat $129 for a standard residential line.
Water heater replacement quotes are free and done in person during business hours.
We never quote a full repair price over the phone - the plumber confirms on site.

scenarios.label: 💧 Burst pipe at night
scenarios.text: Hi, a pipe just burst in our laundry room and water is pouring across the floor. I got the main shut off but we need a plumber tonight.

scenarios.label: 🚿 Water heater leaking
scenarios.text: Hello, our water heater is leaking all over the garage floor and the puddle keeps growing. It is a fifty-gallon tank, maybe ten years old.

scenarios.label: 🧾 Drain quote
scenarios.text: Hey, our kitchen sink drains real slow and keeps backing up. What would it cost to get the line cleared this week?
